verdict.rationale: skills.sh hosts a Skills Leaderboard, and community users confirm it ranks skills by install telemetry. The CLI adds keyword and interactive search (`npx skills find react --owner vercel`), org- or user-wide search, and `--list` to view a repo's skills without installing. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the leaderboard's browsing features and ranking methodology (community calls the ranking opaque), and no programmatic catalog API (users are requesting a REST API).
